question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution mentions about the recommendations of the Finance Commission?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 281**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 281** of the Indian Constitution mentions about the recommendations of the Finance Commission.
 
• The Finance Commission is a constitutional body that is constituted by the President of India every five years.
 
• Its primary function is to define the financial relations between the central government and the individual state governments.
 
• Article 281 outlines the duty of the President to lay the recommendations made by the Finance Commission before each House of Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Finance Commission is constituted under **Article 280** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It is responsible for making recommendations regarding the distribution of tax revenues between the Union and the States and among the States themselves.
 
• The Commission also suggests measures to augment the Consolidated Fund of a State to supplement the resources of the Panchayats and Municipalities in the state.
